payload.comment: Model search is internally consistent: 4/4 trials completed across 2 rounds as planned; selection of res_cnn_wider_d3 (val_acc 0.9708, macro-F1 0.9706) is correct under the accuracy-then-macro-F1 rule with 0.005 tolerance (next-best resnet18_deep_d4 at 0.9604 is outside tolerance); test_metrics_used=false confirmed; config_hash matches between trial and best_config; final config correctly escalates epochs 2→15 and patience 1→3 per search_plan.final_epochs.
